extracted.name: Chili Cheese Dip
extracted.description: This quick, easy chili cheese dip recipe is a little different from most and is sure to be a favorite!
instruction_lines: Spread cream cheese on the bottom of a microwave-safe dish. Spread a layer of chili over cream cheese. Finish with a layer of shredded Cheddar cheese.
Microwave until cheese melts, about 5 minutes. Serve with spicy nacho tortilla chips.
